tests.name: Anonymous access cannot read training records or submit work
Invite binds verified email; wrong student cannot enroll
Student cannot edit curriculum, escalate roles or see another student
Admin edits courses and lessons; reviewer cannot edit curriculum
Lesson progress and submission drafts persist behind ownership policies
Server enforces HTTPS, target assignment, pending review and revision-only resubmission
Hard deadline is enforced by database, including lesson progress
Certificate requires all required modules and assigned project; issue and revoke follow real reviews
